refinement_rule: Refine every acquisition/withdrawal/cadence family's best coarse setting for each cash objective; keep its seed count fixed. Report this as local refinement, not a continuous global optimum.
fixed_amount_rule: For the union of the main search winners by cash objective, test all fixed monthly-accrual amounts with backlog across all three request cadences and the entire coarse reserve grid. This is a focused extension, not exhaustive fixed-amount optimization.
design: One MNQ per accepted signal per account; wait until flat; every free live account copies. Full 2020-July2026 tape optimizes the specified $1000+$200/month budget. Initial funded seats replace the first ordinary monthly purchase; weekly scheduling still acts on Mondays. All later purchases require cash and obey the live cap. Fees stay at inherited $200 with immediate funded-seat availability. Both ongoing and terminal-inclusive cash are ranked. Historical transfers reuse fixed selected policies and are not independent out-of-sample validation. No account product, contract size, evaluation pipeline, phase, signal filter or rulebook optimization.
